reason: I'd probably grab the free week, but I wouldn't pay yet. 'Reviewed by a women's health physio' with no name or credentials doesn't tell me who actually designed it, and with my diastasis I'd rather take it to my own physio first than trust a mum-of-three program off Instagram.
objection: Who is the physio, what are their qualifications, and how much did they really shape the program? A program made by a mum and only 'reviewed' by someone I can't check isn't the same as one built by a clinician.
would_change_my_mind: A named, AHPRA-registered women's health physio who co-designed the program and says clearly who it suits, plus my own physio saying it's fine for my gap.
